```javascript
let count=0;const test=(name,fn)=>{fn();console.log('PASS '+name);count++;};
const now=new Date('2026-10-22T20:00:00+08:00').getTime(),p={title:'合成测试：分析静态工作点',taskId:'',minutes:25,cutoff:now+3600000,energy:'high'};
const start=(overrides={})=>T.start(T.empty(),{...p,...overrides},now,'test');
test('pure transitions and precise budget expiry despite delayed callbacks',()=>{const b=start(),c=T.sync(b,now+3600000);assert.equal(b.active.elapsedMs,0);assert.equal(c.active.elapsedMs,1500000);assert.equal(c.active.finishedAt,now+1500000);assert.equal(c.active.phase,'review');});
test('hard cutoff caps running time, including restart hours later',()=>{const b=start({cutoff:now+300000});const c=T.sync(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(b)),now+86400000);assert.equal(c.active.elapsedMs,300000);assert.equal(c.active.reason,'cutoff');});
test('pause excludes elapsed time but cannot pause the hard cutoff',()=>{const b=T.control(start(),'pause',now+60000);assert.equal(T.sync(b,now+120000).active.elapsedMs,60000);assert.equal(T.sync(b,now+3600000).active.reason,'cutoff');});
test('resume counts only running intervals',()=>{let b=T.control(start(),'pause',now+60000);b=T.control(b,'resume',now+180000);assert.equal(T.sync(b,now+240000).active.elapsedMs,120000);});
test('past dates never silently roll to tomorrow',()=>{assert.throws(()=>start({cutoff:now-1}),/底线/);assert.throws(()=>start({minutes:0}));assert.throws(()=>start({minutes:1.5}));});
test('unfinished decisions require exact blocker and split requires next step',()=>{const b=T.control(start(),'finish',now+60000);assert.throws(()=>T.decide(b,{decision:'defer'},now+60000));assert.throws(()=>T.decide(b,{decision:'split',blocker:'不会列式'},now+60000));const c=T.decide(b,{decision:'split',blocker:'不会列式',next:'先画直流通路'},now+60000);assert.equal(c.active,null);assert.equal(c.draft.title,'先画直流通路');assert.equal(c.draft.cutoff,null);});
test('extensions capped at three and 30 minutes, never beyond cutoff',()=>{let b=T.control(start(),'finish',now+60000);assert.throws(()=>T.decide(b,{decision:'extend',blocker:'卡点',next:'小步',minutes:15},p.cutoff-60000));for(let i=0;i<3;i++){b=T.decide(b,{decision:'extend',blocker:'卡点',next:'小步',minutes:10},now+60000+i*120000);b=T.control(b,'finish',now+120000+i*120000);}assert.throws(()=>T.decide(b,{decision:'extend',blocker:'卡点',next:'小步',minutes:1},now+500000));assert.equal(b.records.length,3);});
test('completed round saves once; no implicit actual time or task completion',()=>{const s=G.newState();s.timerBoard=T.decide(T.control(start(),'finish',now+60000),{decision:'done'},now+60000);assert.equal(s.logs.length,0);assert.equal(s.timerBoard.records.length,1);assert.throws(()=>T.decide(s.timerBoard,{decision:'done'}));G.validateState(s);});
test('old schema3 data unchanged; new timer survives full export/import',()=>{const old=G.newState();assert.deepEqual(G.upgradeState(old),old);const s={...old,timerBoard:start()};assert.deepEqual(G.parseImport(G.exportData(s)).state,s);assert.deepEqual(old,G.newState());});
test('invalid imported timer rejects rather than corrupting original collections',()=>{const s=G.newState();s.timerBoard=start();s.timerBoard.active.remainingMs=-10;assert.throws(()=>G.validateState(s));s.timerBoard=T.empty();s.timerBoard.records=[{id:'bad'}];assert.throws(()=>G.validateState(s));});
test('same countdown contract: 45 minute new task with 3 minute cutoff shows 3 minutes, paused budget freezes',()=>{const b=start({minutes:45,cutoff:now+180000});assert.equal(T.displayRemaining(b.active,now),180000);const paused=T.control(b,'pause',now+10000);assert.equal(T.displayRemaining(paused.active,now+30000),170000);assert.equal(T.displayRemaining(paused.active,now+180000),0);});
test('early finish 30 minute task and start unrelated 45 minute session resets all timing fields',()=>{const old=start({minutes:30,cutoff:now+7200000});const done=T.decide(T.control(old,'finish',now+1600000),{decision:'done'},now+1600000);const next=T.start(done,{...p,title:'新的45分钟任务',minutes:45,cutoff:now+7200000},now+1600001,'new');assert.equal(next.active.budgetMs,2700000);assert.equal(next.active.remainingMs,2700000);assert.equal(next.active.elapsedMs,0);assert.equal(T.displayRemaining(next.active,now+1600001),2700000);assert.equal(next.records[0].elapsedMs,1600000);});
test('all new-task outcomes clear deadline; missing cutoff rejected; extension retains same-task boundary',()=>{for(const decision of ['done','defer','split']){const b=T.decide(T.control(start(),'finish',now+60000),{decision,blocker:'具体卡点',next:'新一步'},now+60000);assert.equal(b.draft.cutoff,null);assert.equal(b.draft.cutoffConfirmed,false);T.validate(b);assert.throws(()=>T.start(b,{...p,cutoff:null},now+60000),/重新设置/);assert.deepEqual(G.parseImport(G.exportData({...G.newState(),timerBoard:b})).state.timerBoard,b);}const b=T.decide(T.control(start(),'finish',now+60000),{decision:'extend',blocker:'具体卡点',next:'当前任务下一步',minutes:5},now+60000);assert.equal(b.active.cutoff,p.cutoff);});
test('budget deadline rebases at start after preview expired; manual deadline stays fixed',()=>{const delayed=now+3600000;const auto=T.start(T.empty(),{...p,minutes:45,cutoff:now+2700000,cutoffMode:'budget'},delayed);assert.equal(auto.active.cutoff,delayed+2700000);assert.equal(T.displayRemaining(auto.active,delayed),2700000);const manual=T.start(T.empty(),{...p,minutes:45,cutoff:delayed+120000,cutoffMode:'manual'},delayed);assert.equal(manual.active.cutoff,delayed+120000);assert.equal(T.displayRemaining(manual.active,delayed),120000);assert.throws(()=>start({cutoffMode:'unknown'}));});
test('budget mode survives export; latest budget used; resume never rebases deadline',()=>{let b=start({minutes:15,cutoffMode:'budget'});const cutoff=b.active.cutoff;assert.equal(cutoff,now+900000);assert.deepEqual(G.parseImport(G.exportData({...G.newState(),timerBoard:b})).state.timerBoard,b);b=T.control(b,'pause',now+60000);b=T.control(b,'resume',now+120000);assert.equal(b.active.cutoff,cutoff);assert.equal(T.sync(b,now+180000).active.cutoff,cutoff);});
console.log(count+' timer core test groups passed');
```

```markdown
# T计划桌面与界面验收计划

状态：PREPARED。此文件是待执行计划，尚未构成通过证据。

范围来自本轮用户授权与根代理分工：按参考图调整界面、改名 T计划、制作真正的 Windows 原生独立窗口软件包；保持 schema 3、现有任务、投入、课程学习记录、看板和纯文本复制功能。Android 仅作为后续方向，本轮不以 390px 响应式页面宣称已交付 Android 软件。

参考图：`C:/Users/fanzi/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-clipboard-e537d13a-1bbe-41ea-bafd-100fb08c6140.png`。参考图用于界面层次、蓝白配色、圆角卡片与课程三标签；其中示例课程、时间和学习成果不作为事实来源。测控软件技术继续第 3–8 周、周一 7–8 节及周三 9–10 节。

## 执行门槛

- 等根代理明确运行文件冻结、批准的预览 URL、Windows 包路径和原生自动化合同后，才启动浏览器或软件。测试不得下载、安装依赖或启动自己的预览服务。
- 历史 `file://` 导航限制继续有效，不运行旧脚本的文件地址，也不以另一浏览器绕过限制。HTTP 验收只接收根代理提供的 `127.0.0.1` 白名单地址；原生软件使用明确批准的本地虚拟 HTTPS 内容源。
- 所有数据使用合成验收数据。浏览器用新 context，原生软件必须有隔离测试 profile 参数；不读写现有用户浏览器、WebView2 profile 或系统剪贴板内容。
- 保留历史报告、脚本和证据。新增脚本仅 `tests/tplan-*`；输出仅 `tests/desktop-evidence/`；最终报告 `T计划_桌面与UI验收.md`。

## UI 与旧功能回归

| 编号 | 实际路径与主要判据 | 证据 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| U1 | Chrome、Edge 各自空 profile 打开；文档与可见品牌 T计划，仍只有今日/本周/看板/记录/周总结五个导航；空状态不写入样例或学习内容 | 标题、导航、storage 断言 |
| U2 | 1440px 与 390px 实际点击五页；无页面横向溢出，正文/按钮/图例可读，底部导航不遮住最后一条内容；首页有且最多一个主任务、最多两个次要任务 | 各页截图，尺寸与可见性断言 |
| U3 | 今日/课表打开空课程，三标签都有正确 role/aria；点击与键盘切换，空计划不生成知识；复制本节课程仍能取得完整纯文本 | 三标签、空数据、复制回退 |

| U6 | 相关任务标签创建默认 30 分钟的课后任务，重复入口只编辑原关联任务；完成任务不制造实际分钟，真实投入录入/编辑只计一次 | 任务/计划关联与周统计 |

原 V1.2 测试适配点：课程弹窗改为三个互斥可见 panel，原先一次读取全部弹窗正文的断言需先切对应 tab；`course-copy` 在 plan、`course-copy-record` 在 record、`course-review-task` 在 tasks。按原始业务预期检查数据，不因标签变化删除功能断言。`tgrowth.v1` 存储键及 schema 3 不随品牌更名重置。

## 原生 Windows 包专项

| 编号 | 实际路径与主要判据 | 必须区分的边界 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| W1 | 从隔离解压目录直接启动真实 EXE，出现名为 T计划的独立原生窗口；记录 EXE、窗口和子进程身份 | WebView2 子进程允许；不得把 Edge --app 或新 Chrome/Edge 浏览器窗口当成原生封装 |
| W2 | 默认启动不启用调试参数；检查应用自身及子进程监听端口，不依赖本机 HTTP 服务 | 调试模式 CDP 监听需单独标注，不与默认启动检查混淆 |
| W3 | 通过批准的原生虚拟 HTTPS 地址观察资源与请求；关闭外部网络后验证可用范围 | 不使用 file 导航；外部请求与虚拟源本地资源分开；若只测已加载断网，不声称断网首次启动 |
| W4 | 在隔离 profile 通过真实 UI 保存合成数据，正常关闭并重新启动同一包；所有字段一致 | 不靠同一进程未退出伪装重启，不使用用户实际 profile |
| W5 | 原生 UI JSON 导出、清空、导入以及坏 JSON 拒绝；schema 2 旧备份迁移 | Web 浏览器旧存储不会假称自动迁移到新原生 profile；以显式 JSON 导入验证 |
| W6 | 将同一发行包复制/重新解压到另一隔离目录，使用同一测试 profile 再启动，原数据完整 | 移动的是软件文件，不是用户数据；验证稳定 profile 路径与内容 origin |
| W7 | 包内文件清单与内容抽查，无 localStorage、profile、历史 JSON、个人 PDF/截图、测试证据或用户记录 | 运行必需资源允许，合成数据只在包外隔离 profile |
| W8 | 交付源文件/单文件/Windows 包版本一致，核心数据文件未改；软件窗口退出后只结束本轮创建的测试子进程 | 记录最终 SHA256 与实际运行对象；不关闭用户自己的浏览器或程序 |

需根代理提供：最终 EXE/ZIP 与封装源码路径、虚拟 HTTPS origin、默认数据目录、隔离 profile 参数、仅测试时启用的自动化/CDP 参数、正常退出方式、已安装 WebView2 运行时要求。未满足的项目记录 NOT RUN/NOT VERIFIED，不能以其他层面 PASS 替代。
```

```javascript
async function stateOf(p){return p.evaluate(()=>JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('tgrowth.v1')));}
async function nav(p,view){await p.locator(`nav [data-page="${view}"]`).click();}
async function action(p,name,scope='#app',id){await p.locator(`${scope} [data-action="${name}"]${id?`[data-id="${id}"]`:''}`).first().click();}
async function submit(p){await p.locator('#dialog form button[type="submit"]').click();await p.locator('#dialog').waitFor({state:'hidden'});}
async function upload(p,data){await p.locator('#import-file').setInputFiles({name:'synthetic.json',mimeType:'application/json',buffer:Buffer.from(typeof data==='string'?data:JSON.stringify(data))});await action(p,'confirm-import','#dialog');}
async function chooseWeek(p,num){await p.locator('#week-number').fill(String(num));await p.locator('#week-number').dispatchEvent('change');}
```

```markdown
# T计划图标

`tplan-icon-source.png` 使用内置 imagegen 工具，根据用户提供的 T计划 UI 板左上角图标生成。保留蓝色 T、右上双叶嫩芽、白色圆角底与浅冰蓝内层。生成结果已经目视检查；`tplan-icon-128.png` 和 `tplan.ico` 是通过 `desktop/convert-icon.ps1` 作尺寸/容器格式转换，ICO 含 16/32/48/64/128/256 六档。

界面直接嵌入 128px PNG 的 data URI，无远程素材加载。Windows EXE 使用同一图标资源。原始用户图片未修改。

生成提示词：

> Create ONE production-ready square desktop/mobile app icon for T计划 using the supplied poster as visual reference. Isolate and faithfully recreate ONLY the top-left app logo: a large bold simple capital T in vivid blue with a gentle blue gradient and subtle dimensional edge, and a small dark blue two-leaf sprout growing at its upper-right. Set inside a white, softly rounded square with a pale ice-blue inset and very soft tasteful shadow, matching the reference identity and proportions. Front-on view, crisp polished minimal UI app icon, centered, legible at 32px. Transparent background OUTSIDE the rounded white square. No Chinese text, no app name, no phone, no poster, no landscape, no extra lettering or decorative elements. Render a single square high-resolution icon suitable for PNG and Windows ICO; preserve the T + sprout visual identity from the reference.

```

````markdown
# Microsoft WebView2 构建输入来源

记录时间：2026-09-07 21:38（Asia/Shanghai）。本记录中的下载仅用于构建输入；未安装或修改系统 WebView2，未从已安装的 Evergreen 目录复制 Runtime。

## WebView2 SDK

- NuGet 包：`Microsoft.Web.WebView2` **1.0.4191.47**。
- 官方包来源：<https://www.nuget.org/api/v2/package/Microsoft.Web.WebView2/1.0.4191.47>。
- 本地包：`Microsoft.Web.WebView2.1.0.4191.47.nupkg`，9,259,926 字节。
- 包 SHA-256（已重新读取本地文件计算）：`F492BBF547D0DA329553B6727435B677579B1E9F91CC9E4A1AD029366D5F23D0`。
- 解包目录：`sdk/`；`sdk/Microsoft.Web.WebView2.nuspec` 已核对包名、版本及 Microsoft 作者字段。
- SDK 许可：[sdk/LICENSE.txt](sdk/LICENSE.txt)；附带通知：[sdk/NOTICE.txt](sdk/NOTICE.txt)。二进制分发需随材料保留其版权说明、许可条件和免责声明，不得暗示 Microsoft 背书。
- SDK 与 Fixed Runtime 是不同构建输入；本应用使用 SDK 的 .NET Framework Core/WinForms 程序集和 x64 `WebView2Loader.dll`，不能仅携带 Runtime CAB。

## Fixed Version Runtime

- 产品：Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime (Fixed Version)
- 版本：**152.0.4191.62**
- 架构：**x64**（已读取 `msedgewebview2.exe` 的 PE Machine：`0x8664`）
- 官方下载页面：<https://developer.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/webview2/>
- 选择依据：下载页面响应内嵌的 Fixed Version 下载数据提供的 152 系列 x64 包；没有猜测 URL，也没有使用第三方镜像。本机系统 Evergreen 的 152.0.4191.66 不作为 Fixed Version 的版本依据。
- 直接下载 URL：<https://msedge.sf.dl.delivery.mp.microsoft.com/filestreamingservice/files/0a4a34d9-ccaa-4cef-98b4-58cb313fbfeb/Microsoft.WebView2.FixedVersionRuntime.152.0.4191.62.x64.cab>
- CAB 相对位置：`runtime/Microsoft.WebView2.FixedVersionRuntime.152.0.4191.62.x64.cab`
- CAB 大小：**371,877,369 字节**（约 354.65 MiB）
- CAB SHA-256（本地下载后计算，非上游另行发布的校验值）：`2DC7D817DDCE4D036F33684425C218F1CA2D073911136E5D3F8CE9B2340569B5`

使用 Windows `C:\Windows\System32\expand.exe` 解包，返回码为 0；保留完整目录结构，未删减 Runtime 文件。解包日志：`runtime/expand-152.0.4191.62-x64.log`。

```powershell
expand.exe "runtime\Microsoft.WebView2.FixedVersionRuntime.152.0.4191.62.x64.cab" -F:* "runtime"
```

真正的 Runtime 根目录：

```text
D:\Personal_work_station\Projects\T成长\desktop\vendor\runtime\Microsoft.WebView2.FixedVersionRuntime.152.0.4191.62.x64
```

宿主的 `browserExecutableFolder` / `BrowserExecutableFolder` 必须指向含 `msedgewebview2.exe` 的上述目录。发布构建复制该目录中的全部文件，**不复制上一层 CAB 或解包日志**。

验证结果：

- 解包文件数：**548**；文件大小合计：**837,201,247 字节**（约 798.42 MiB）。
- `msedgewebview2.exe` 大小：4,824,392 字节。
- EXE FileVersion：`152.0.4191.62`。
- EXE SHA-256：`0F75BA7DA899408D4C4474D58358BDBEE732705FC090161CBF08E8783520572D`。
- Windows Authenticode：`Valid`；签名主体为 `CN=Microsoft Corporation, O=Microsoft Corporation, L=Redmond, S=Washington, C=US`。
- 本步骤不启动宿主或 Runtime；应用启动、实际内核选择、离线请求行为与干净电脑运行情况由后续打包验收验证。

## 官方许可

许可标题：**MICROSOFT SOFTWARE LICENSE TERMS — MICROSOFT EDGE WEBVIEW2 RUNTIME (FIXED VERSION)**。

- 原文副本：[WebView2-Fixed-Runtime-LICENSE.html](WebView2-Fixed-Runtime-LICENSE.html)
- 官方许可接口：<https://developer.microsoft.com/microsoft-edge/api/eula/webview2?fixed=true>
- 发现方式：官网下载页面的 `BlockWebView2` 下载控件在 `ensureEula` 中使用此接口；读取返回 JSON 的 `fixedHtml`，响应状态 200，语言 `en-us`。
- 页面控件脚本：<https://edgecdn-embza6g8cacagcbn.z01.azurefd.net/shared/edgeweb/_nuxt/CXzXwfXG.js>
- 保存的 HTML SHA-256：`13ABE52770BE9206CD86A6F4564C2923813D4FBAEF8913D6A8704E4EC5C51B03`。

以下为便于构建审查的条款索引，不能替代许可原文：第 2 节说明随应用分发对象代码的权利及要求，包括应用提供自身主要功能、下游条款保护、直接从 Microsoft 获取分发代码等条件；保留 Runtime 中原有第三方许可文件。第 4、8 节说明数据处理与 SmartScreen 默认开启情况：如果未禁用 SmartScreen，必须提供相应用户告知。应用的严格离线要求仍需由宿主配置和实际网络行为验收落实；下载并固定 Runtime 版本本身不等于已经验证所有网络请求为零。

Runtime 自带 `show_third_party_software_licenses.bat`、`Trust Protection Lists/Mu/LICENSE`、`Trust Protection Lists/Sigma/LICENSE`、`WidevineCdm/LICENSE`，均原样保留；未执行该批处理。

## 官方分发注意点

来源：<https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/webview2/concepts/distribution#the-fixed-version-runtime-distribution-mode>

- Fixed Version 随应用提供全部解包文件，并在 WebView2 初始化前指定其目录；不依赖已有系统 Evergreen 注册信息，不自行更新。后续 Runtime 更新须随应用重新发布。
- Windows 10 上，Fixed Version 120 及以上的未打包 Win32 应用，需给**实际部署的 Runtime 目录**增加以下两个应用容器组的读取和执行权限。普通 Inno Setup 安装的 WinForms 程序仍应按未打包 Win32 场景处理。本次未修改 ACL；由安装/启动步骤在最终目标目录实现并验证。

```powershell
icacls "<实际部署的 Fixed Runtime 目录>" /grant "*S-1-15-2-2:(OI)(CI)(RX)"
icacls "<实际部署的 Fixed Runtime 目录>" /grant "*S-1-15-2-1:(OI)(CI)(RX)"
```

- 上述特殊 ACL 要求不适用于 Windows 11；不要为此移除现有文件夹权限或给用户数据目录扩权。
- Fixed Version 不支持从网络位置/UNC 路径运行。
- 宿主仍需同时发布匹配 x64 的 `WebView2Loader.dll` 和所需 .NET WebView2 Core/WinForms 程序集；Runtime CAB 不替代 SDK。
- 下载/解包成功不能代替 Windows 10、Windows 11、目标 .NET Framework 条件和干净机器上的应用验收。

````

```javascript
/* T计划智能版：独立于原 T计划 的浏览器数据空间。 */
(() => {
  'use strict';
  const KEY = 'tplan.smart.v1', app = document.querySelector('#app');
  const days = ['周一','周二','周三','周四','周五','周六','周日'];
  const empty = () => ({version:1, semesterStart:'', weekCount:20, courses:[], tasks:[], goal:'', hoursPerWeek:10});
  const esc = value => String(value ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
  const clone = value => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value));
  let state, page = 'today', week = 1, preview = null, analysis = null, fileName = '';
  function toast(message){const node=document.querySelector('#toast');node.textContent=message;node.hidden=false;clearTimeout(toast.timer);toast.timer=setTimeout(()=>node.hidden=true,5500);}
  function uuid(){return crypto.randomUUID ? crypto.randomUUID() : 'c-'+Date.now()+'-'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);}
  function monday(value){const d=new Date(value+'T12:00:00');return !Number.isNaN(d.getTime())&&d.getDay()===1;}
  function validCourse(c){
    if(!c||typeof c.name!=='string'||!c.name.trim()||c.name.length>100)throw Error('课程名称不能为空且不超过100字');
    if(!Number.isInteger(c.day)||c.day<1||c.day>7||!Number.isInteger(c.start)||!Number.isInteger(c.end)||c.start<1||c.end<c.start||c.end>20)throw Error('星期或节次无效');
    if(!Array.isArray(c.weeks)||!c.weeks.length||c.weeks.some(x=>!Number.isInteger(x)||x<1||x>30))throw Error('课程周次无效');
    if((c.teacher||'').length>100||(c.room||'').length>100)throw Error('教师或教室过长');
    return {...c,name:c.name.trim(),weeks:[...new Set(c.weeks)].sort((a,b)=>a-b)};
  }
  function validate(s){
    if(!s||s.version!==1||!Array.isArray(s.courses)||!Array.isArray(s.tasks)||s.courses.length>250||s.tasks.length>1000)throw Error('数据格式无效');
    if(s.semesterStart&&!monday(s.semesterStart))throw Error('学期首周日期必须是周一');
    if(!Number.isInteger(s.weekCount)||s.weekCount<1||s.weekCount>30)throw Error('教学周数应为1至30');
    const ids=new Set();s.courses.forEach(c=>{validCourse(c);if(!c.id||ids.has(c.id))throw Error('课程ID重复');ids.add(c.id);});
    s.tasks.forEach(t=>{if(!t.id||typeof t.title!=='string'||!t.title.trim()||t.title.length>100||!/^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$/.test(t.date)||!Number.isInteger(t.minutes)||t.minutes<0||t.minutes>1440)throw Error('任务格式无效');});
    if(typeof s.goal!=='string'||s.goal.length>1000||!Number.isFinite(s.hoursPerWeek)||s.hoursPerWeek<0||s.hoursPerWeek>168)throw Error('目标或可用时间无效');
    return s;
  }
  try{state=validate(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY))) }catch(error){if(localStorage.getItem(KEY)){state=null;setTimeout(()=>toast('本地数据无法读取，已停止写入。请先从数据管理导出原始备份。'),0);}else state=empty();}
  function save(next){if(!state)throw Error('本地数据异常，已停止写入');validate(next);localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(next));state=next;render();}
  const head=(title,sub,actions='')=>`<header class="head"><div><h1>${title}</h1><p class="muted">${sub}</p></div><div class="toolbar">${actions}</div></header>`;
  const button=(text,action,cls='secondary',extra='')=>`<button type="button" class="${cls}" data-action="${action}" ${extra}>${text}</button>`;
  function weekDate(w,day=1){if(!state.semesterStart)return '';const d=new Date(state.semesterStart+'T12:00:00');d.setDate(d.getDate()+(w-1)*7+day-1);return `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')}`;}
  function actualWeek(){if(!state.semesterStart)return null;const start=new Date(state.semesterStart+'T12:00:00'),today=new Date();const days=(Date.UTC(today.getFullYear(),today.getMonth(),today.getDate())-Date.UTC(start.getFullYear(),start.getMonth(),start.getDate()))/86400000;const value=Math.floor(days/7)+1;return value>=1&&value<=state.weekCount?value:null;}
  function currentWeek(){return actualWeek()||1;}
  function conflicts(courses){const rows=[];for(let i=0;i<courses.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<courses.length;j++){const a=courses[i],b=courses[j];if(a.day!==b.day||a.end<b.start||b.end<a.start)continue;const overlap=a.weeks.filter(w=>b.weeks.includes(w));if(overlap.length)rows.push(`${a.name} 与 ${b.name}：周${a.day}第${Math.max(a.start,b.start)}–${Math.min(a.end,b.end)}节，第${overlap.join('、')}周`);}return rows;}
  function schedule(){const active=state.courses.filter(c=>c.weeks.includes(week));const overlaps=conflicts(active);let html=`<div class="week-nav">${button('‹ 上一周','prev','secondary small',week===1?'disabled':'')}<strong>第 ${week} / ${state.weekCount} 教学周</strong>${button('下一周 ›','next','secondary small',week===state.weekCount?'disabled':'')}${button('本周','this-week','secondary small')}<span class="muted">${esc(weekDate(week))}${state.semesterStart?' — '+esc(weekDate(week,7)):''}</span></div>`;
    html+=`<div class="schedule-wrap"><table class="schedule"><thead><tr><th>节次</th>${days.map((d,i)=>`<th>${d}<br><small>${esc(weekDate(week,i+1).slice(5))}</small></th>`).join('')}</tr></thead><tbody>`;
    for(let slot=1;slot<=10;slot++)html+=`<tr><th>${slot}</th>${days.map((_,i)=>`<td>${active.filter(c=>c.day===i+1&&c.start===slot).map(c=>`<button class="course ${overlaps.some(x=>x.includes(c.name))?'conflict':''}" data-action="edit-course" data-id="${esc(c.id)}"><strong>${esc(c.name)}</strong><small>${c.start}–${c.end}节 · ${esc(c.room||'地点待确认')}</small></button>`).join('')}</td>`).join('')}</tr>`;
    html+='</tbody></table></div>';return html;
  }
  function today(){const now=new Date(),todayISO=`${now.getFullYear()}-${String(now.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(now.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')}`;const day=(now.getDay()+6)%7+1;const w=actualWeek();const courses=w===null?[]:state.courses.filter(c=>c.day===day&&c.weeks.includes(w));const tasks=state.tasks.filter(t=>t.date===todayISO);
    const scheduleNotice=!state.semesterStart?'<p class=notice>尚未设置学期第一周的周一，无法判断今天属于第几教学周。请先到“我的课表”填写日期。</p>':w===null?'<p class=notice>今天不在所设置学期的教学周范围内；可到“我的课表”查看历史或未来周。</p>':'';return head('今日','课程和任务分开记录，完成任务不自动计入学习时长。',button('查看课表','go-schedule','primary'))+scheduleNotice+`<div class="stats"><div class="stat">今日课程<strong>${courses.length}</strong></div><div class="stat">今日任务<strong>${tasks.length}</strong></div><div class="stat">待完成<strong>${tasks.filter(t=>!t.done).length}</strong></div></div><div class="grid2"><section class="card"><h2>今日课程</h2>${courses.length?courses.map(c=>`<div class="list-item"><strong>${esc(c.name)}</strong><p class="muted">${c.start}–${c.end}节 · ${esc(c.room||'地点待确认')}</p></div>`).join(''):'<p class="empty">今天暂无已导入课程。</p>'}</section><section class="card"><h2>今日任务</h2>${tasks.length?tasks.map(taskRow).join(''):'<p class="empty">今天暂无任务。</p>'}</section></div>`;
  }
  function taskRow(t){return `<div class="list-item"><div class="row between"><strong>${esc(t.title)}</strong><span class="badge">${t.done?'已完成':'待完成'}</span></div><p class="muted">${esc(t.date)} · 预计 ${t.minutes} 分钟</p><div class="actions">${button(t.done?'标记未完成':'标记完成','toggle-task','secondary small',`data-id="${esc(t.id)}"`)}${button('删除','delete-task','danger small',`data-id="${esc(t.id)}"`)}</div></div>`;}
  function tasksPage(){return head('学习计划','记录具体任务和预估时间。',button('＋ 新建任务','add-task','primary'))+`<section class="card"><h2>任务列表</h2>${state.tasks.length?state.tasks.slice().sort((a,b)=>a.date.localeCompare(b.date)).map(taskRow).join(''):'<p class="empty">还没有任务。</p>'}</section>`;}
  function previewRows(){if(!preview)return '';return `<section class="card" id="preview"><div class="row between"><h2>导入预览 · ${esc(fileName)}</h2><span class="badge">${preview.mode==='ai'?'AI 识别':'本地规则识别'}</span></div><p class="hint">逐行核对名称、星期、节次和周次。可直接修改或删除；确认后替换当前课表，任务仍保留。</p>${preview.warnings.map(w=>`<p class="notice">${esc(w)}</p>`).join('')}<div class="preview-head preview-row"><span>课程名称</span><span>星期</span><span>开始节</span><span>结束节</span><span>教学周</span><span>教师</span><span>教室</span><span></span></div><div id="preview-list">${preview.courses.map((c,i)=>`<div class="preview-row" data-row="${i}"><input aria-label="课程名称" name="name" value="${esc(c.name)}"><input aria-label="星期" name="day" type="number" min="1" max="7" value="${c.day}"><input aria-label="开始节" name="start" type="number" min="1" max="20" value="${c.start}"><input aria-label="结束节" name="end" type="number" min="1" max="20" value="${c.end}"><input aria-label="教学周" name="weeks" value="${esc(Array.isArray(c.weeks)?c.weeks.join(','):c.weeks)}"><input aria-label="教师" name="teacher" value="${esc(c.teacher)}"><input aria-label="教室" name="room" value="${esc(c.room)}">${button('删除','remove-preview','danger small',`data-row="${i}"`)}</div>`).join('')}</div><div class="actions">${button('＋ 增加一行','add-preview')}${button('取消','cancel-preview')}${button('核对并导入','commit-preview','primary')}</div></section>`;}
```

```python
"""Read timetable candidates without executing uploaded documents."""
from __future__ import annotations

import csv
import io
import re
import zipfile
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

MAX_FILE = 10 * 1024 * 1024
MAX_XML = 8 * 1024 * 1024
DAY = {"一": 1, "二": 2, "三": 3, "四": 4, "五": 5, "六": 6, "日": 7, "天": 7}
OFFICE_NS = {"m": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main",
             "w": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main"}


def _xml_part(zf: zipfile.ZipFile, name: str):
    info = zf.getinfo(name)
    if info.file_size > MAX_XML:
        raise ValueError("文档中的 XML 部分过大")
    return ET.fromstring(zf.read(name))


def extract_xlsx(data: bytes) -> str:
    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(data)) as zf:
        strings = []
        if "xl/sharedStrings.xml" in zf.namelist():
            root = _xml_part(zf, "xl/sharedStrings.xml")
            strings = ["".join(t.text or "" for t in si.findall(".//m:t", OFFICE_NS))
                       for si in root.findall("m:si", OFFICE_NS)]
        sheets = sorted(n for n in zf.namelist() if re.fullmatch(r"xl/worksheets/sheet\d+\.xml", n))
        if not sheets:
            raise ValueError("Excel 文件没有可读取的工作表")
        lines = []
        for name in sheets[:10]:
            root = _xml_part(zf, name)
            lines.append("# " + name)
            for row in root.findall(".//m:sheetData/m:row", OFFICE_NS)[:300]:
                cells = []
                for cell in row.findall("m:c", OFFICE_NS)[:30]:
                    value = cell.find("m:v", OFFICE_NS)
                    if cell.attrib.get("t") == "inlineStr":
                        text = "".join(t.text or "" for t in cell.findall(".//m:t", OFFICE_NS))
                    elif value is not None:
                        text = value.text or ""
                        if cell.attrib.get("t") == "s":
                            idx = int(text)
                            text = strings[idx] if 0 <= idx < len(strings) else ""
                    else:
                        text = ""
                    if text.strip():
                        cells.append(f"{cell.attrib.get('r', '')}:{text.strip()}")
                if cells:
                    lines.append(" | ".join(cells))
        return "\n".join(lines)[:100000]


def extract_docx(data: bytes) -> str:
    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(data)) as zf:
        root = _xml_part(zf, "word/document.xml")
        lines = []
        for para in root.findall(".//w:p", OFFICE_NS):
            line = "".join(t.text or "" for t in para.findall(".//w:t", OFFICE_NS)).strip()
            if line:
                lines.append(line)
        return "\n".join(lines)[:100000]


def extract_svg(data: bytes) -> str:
    root = ET.fromstring(data)
    return "\n".join((e.text or "").strip() for e in root.iter()
                     if e.tag.rsplit("}", 1)[-1] in {"text", "tspan"} and (e.text or "").strip())[:100000]


def extract_text(name: str, data: bytes) -> str | None:
    if len(data) > MAX_FILE:
        raise ValueError("文件超过 10 MB")
    ext = name.lower().rsplit(".", 1)[-1]
    if ext == "xlsx":
        return extract_xlsx(data)
    if ext == "docx":
        return extract_docx(data)
    if ext == "svg":
        return extract_svg(data)
    if ext in {"csv", "txt"}:
        return data.decode("utf-8-sig", errors="replace")[:100000]
    if ext in {"pdf", "png", "jpg", "jpeg"}:
        return None
    raise ValueError("支持 xlsx、docx、csv、txt、pdf、png、jpg、svg；旧版 xls/doc 请另存为新版格式")


def parse_simple_lines(text: str) -> list[dict]:
    """Conservative local parser for one-course-per-line text, never guesses missing weeks."""
    result = []
    pattern = re.compile(r"(?:周|星期)([一二三四五六日天])\s*[，,;；|/\- ]+\s*(\d{1,2})\s*[-–—~至]\s*(\d{1,2})\s*节?\s*[，,;；|/\- ]+\s*(.+?)\s*[，,;；|/\- ]+\s*(?:第)?([\d,，、\s-]+)周")
    for line in text.splitlines():
        match = pattern.search(line)
        if not match:
            continue
        day, first, last, name, weeks_text = match.groups()
        a, b = int(first), int(last)
        if a < 1 or b > 20 or a > b or len(name) > 100:
            continue
        weeks = set()
        for part in re.split(r"[,，、\s]+", weeks_text.strip()):
            if not part:
                continue
            if "-" in part:
                lo, hi = [int(x) for x in part.split("-", 1)]
                if 1 <= lo <= hi <= 30:
                    weeks.update(range(lo, hi + 1))
            elif part.isdigit() and 1 <= int(part) <= 30:
                weeks.add(int(part))
        if weeks:
            result.append({"name": name.strip(), "day": DAY[day], "start": a, "end": b,
                           "weeks": sorted(weeks), "teacher": "", "room": ""})
    return result


def parse_excel_grid(text: str) -> list[dict]:
    """Read a common grid: weekday headers above period rows, explicit weeks in each cell."""
    result = []
    rows = []
    for line in text.splitlines():
        cells = {}
        for item in line.split(" | "):
            match = re.match(r"([A-Z]+)(\d+):(.*)", item, re.S)
            if match:
                cells[match.group(1)] = match.group(3).strip()
        if cells:
            rows.append(cells)
    headers = {}
    header_index = -1
    for i, row in enumerate(rows):
        found = {col: DAY[m.group(1)] for col, value in row.items()
                 if (m := re.search(r"(?:周|星期)([一二三四五六日天])", value))}
        if len(found) >= 2:
            headers, header_index = found, i
            break
    if not headers:
        return []
    for row in rows[header_index + 1:]:
        period = next((re.search(r"(\d{1,2})\s*[-–—~至]\s*(\d{1,2})\s*节?", value)
                       for col, value in row.items() if col not in headers and
                       re.search(r"(\d{1,2})\s*[-–—~至]\s*(\d{1,2})\s*节?", value)), None)
        if period is None:
            continue
        first, last = int(period.group(1)), int(period.group(2))
        if first < 1 or last > 20 or first > last:
            continue
        for col, day in headers.items():
            cell = row.get(col, "")
            wm = re.search(r"(?:第)?\s*(\d{1,2})\s*[-–—~至]\s*(\d{1,2})\s*周", cell)
            if not wm:
                wm = re.search(r"(?:第)?\s*(\d{1,2})\s*周", cell)
            if not wm:
                continue
            lo, hi = int(wm.group(1)), int(wm.group(2) or wm.group(1))
            if not 1 <= lo <= hi <= 30:
                continue
            name = re.sub(r"(?:第)?\s*\d{1,2}\s*(?:[-–—~至]\s*\d{1,2})?\s*周", "", cell).strip(" ;；,，、()（）")
            if name:
                result.append({"name": name[:100], "day": day, "start": first, "end": last,
                               "weeks": list(range(lo, hi + 1)), "teacher": "", "room": ""})
    return result


_PDF_MARKER = re.compile(
    r"(?P<weeks>\d[\d,，、\s\-–—~至]*)\(\[\s*周\]\)\[\s*(?P<first>\d{1,2})\s*[-–—~至]\s*(?P<last>\d{1,2})\s*节\]"
)
_ROOM_START = re.compile(r"^(?:[一二三四五六七八九十][东西中教]|东阶|三教|操场|[A-Z]\d|[、，,\d])")


def _weeks(value: str) -> list[int]:
    weeks = set()
    for part in re.split(r"[,，、\s]+", value.strip()):
        if not part:
            continue
        match = re.fullmatch(r"(\d{1,2})(?:[-–—~至](\d{1,2}))?", part)
        if not match:
            return []
        a, b = int(match.group(1)), int(match.group(2) or match.group(1))
        if not 1 <= a <= b <= 30:
            return []
        weeks.update(range(a, b + 1))
    return sorted(weeks)


def _cell_courses(cell: str, day: int) -> tuple[list[dict], list[str]]:
    """Parse stacked course blocks from a text-based PDF table cell."""
    cell = re.sub(r"\(\[\s*周\]\)", "([周])", cell)
    cell = re.sub(r"\[(\d{1,2})\s*[-–—~至]\s*(\d{1,2})\s*节\]", r"[\1-\2节]", cell)
    markers = list(_PDF_MARKER.finditer(cell))
    if not markers:
        return [], ["课表单元格含有文字，但未识别出明确的教学周和节次"] if cell.strip() else []
    courses, warnings = [], []
    end = 0
    for marker in markers:
        lines = [line.strip() for line in cell[end:marker.start()].splitlines() if line.strip()]
        if courses:
            room_lines = []
            while lines and _ROOM_START.match(lines[0]):
                room_lines.append(lines.pop(0))
            courses[-1]["room"] = "".join(room_lines)[:100]
        weeks = _weeks(marker.group("weeks"))
        first, last = int(marker.group("first")), int(marker.group("last"))
        if len(lines) < 2 or not weeks or not 1 <= first <= last <= 20:
            warnings.append("有一处课程名称、教师或周次无法可靠拆分，请在原文件中核对")
        else:
            courses.append({"name": "".join(lines[:-1])[:100], "teacher": lines[-1][:100],
                            "room": "", "day": day, "start": first, "end": last,
                            "weeks": weeks})
        end = marker.end()
    if courses:
        courses[-1]["room"] = "".join(line.strip() for line in cell[end:].splitlines() if line.strip())[:100]
    return courses, warnings


def extract_pdf_courses(data: bytes) -> tuple[list[dict], list[str]]:
    """Text-table PDF path; scanned PDFs remain an explicit unsupported local case."""
    try:
        import pdfplumber
    except ImportError as error:
        raise ValueError("本地 PDF 解析组件 pdfplumber 不可用；请使用项目说明中的 Python 环境，或使用已配置的 AI 识别") from error
    rows, warnings = [], []
    with pdfplumber.open(io.BytesIO(data)) as document:
        if len(document.pages) > 20:
            raise ValueError("PDF 超过 20 页，暂不作为单张课表导入")
        for page_index, page in enumerate(document.pages, 1):
            for table in page.extract_tables():
                headers = None
                for row in table:
                    row = row or []
                    found = {col: DAY[match.group(1)] for col, value in enumerate(row)
                             if value and (match := re.search(r"星期([一二三四五六日天])", value))}
                    if len(found) >= 2:
                        headers = found
                        continue
                    if not headers:
                        continue
                    if row and row[0] and "周" in row[0] and not any(row[col] for col in headers if col < len(row)):
                        notice = "".join(row[0].split())
                        warnings.append(f"第{page_index}页另有无固定星期或节次的安排，未导入课表：{notice[:180]}")
                        continue
                    for col, day in headers.items():
                        if col >= len(row) or not row[col] or not row[col].strip():
                            continue
                        cell_courses, cell_warnings = _cell_courses(row[col], day)
                        rows.extend(cell_courses)
                        warnings.extend(f"第{page_index}页、星期{day}：{warning}" for warning in cell_warnings)
        if not rows:
            warnings.append("PDF 未提取到可确认周次和节次的课程；扫描件或复杂版式可使用 AI 识别")
    return rows, warnings[:30]

```

````markdown
# T计划智能版 · 独立原型

这是基于 T计划「今日／课表／任务／分析／数据」使用骨架新建的软件原型。它在 `smart-plan/` 中运行，**不读取或改写**原 T计划的 `tgrowth.v1`、已安装的 EXE 或 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\TPlan\Profile`。本版是本机网页应用，需要 Python 3.10+；本地 PDF 表格识别另需当前 Python 环境具备 `pdfplumber`。尚未封装成 Windows 安装包或 Android APK。

## 启动

在此目录执行：

```powershell
python server.py --port 18766
```

在这台电脑上，已验证下列 Python 自带 `pdfplumber`，可直接用于本地识别你提供的文字表格 PDF：

```powershell
& 'C:\Users\fanzi\.cache\codex-runtimes\codex-primary-runtime\dependencies\python\python.exe' server.py --port 18766
```

如果换用系统默认 `python` 且其中没有 `pdfplumber`，这份 PDF 的本地识别会提示缺少解析组件。上面的路径属于这台电脑的运行环境，换电脑时须使用具备该组件的 Python。

再在浏览器打开 `http://127.0.0.1:18766/`。服务器仅监听 `127.0.0.1`。个人课表、任务与目标保存在当前浏览器的 `tplan.smart.v1`；更换浏览器、端口或清理站点数据前，先从「数据管理」导出 JSON。此原型不进行自动跨设备同步。

## 课表导入

拖入或选择单个不超过 10 MB 的 `xlsx`、`docx`、`csv`、`txt`、`pdf`、`png`、`jpg/jpeg` 或 `svg`。

- `xlsx`、`docx`、`csv`、`txt`、`svg`：先在本地读取文字。规则识别支持「周一 1-2节, 高等数学, 1-16周」这类逐行写法，以及带星期表头、节次行和明确周次的常见 Excel 网格。复杂版式可选择 AI 识别。
- `pdf`：可选择文字的表格 PDF 会先尝试本地识别；当前 Python 环境须具备 `pdfplumber`。扫描件或无法拆分的复杂表格可选择 AI 识别。
- 图片：当前需要 AI 识别。图片及选择 AI 的 PDF 内容仅在本次勾选「使用 AI 识别」并确认后送往模型接口。模糊图片及复杂合并单元格不保证识别准确。
- 旧版 `.xls`、`.doc` 请先在 Office/WPS 中另存为 `.xlsx`、`.docx`。
- 识别结果始终先进入可编辑预览；空周次不推测，冲突会提示。确认后只替换智能版课表，保留任务。建议导入前先导出备份。

## 模型接口

当前接入 OpenAI Responses API。**不在页面、源码或浏览器存储 API 密钥**。启动前在当前 PowerShell 会话设置环境变量：

```powershell
$env:OPENAI_API_KEY = '<你的密钥>'
$env:OPENAI_MODEL = 'gpt-4.1-mini'
python server.py --port 18766
```

密钥及模型应由你自己选择和配置；模型调用可能产生费用。本地导入和手工课表管理不需要密钥。点击「生成 AI 分析」会先显示发送范围并再次确认，模型只提供建议，不自动修改课表或任务。服务器请求设置 `store: false`；具体数据处理仍受所选 API 服务条款约束。本版尚未用真实密钥验证模型接口。

## 验证

```powershell
python -m unittest -v test_smart_plan.py
node --check app.js
```

已测试本地 Excel 网格、文本、SVG 提取、PDF 叠放课程与隔周周次、未授权图片不发送、无效 AI 课程拒绝和分析输入不变性。2026-09-23 使用 `大二下课表.pdf` 验证了浏览器文件选择 → 本地解析 → 19 个课程场次预览 → 确认导入 → 刷新后保留；另外两项未标明具体星期和节次的活动仅提示人工核对，未猜测并写入课程。PDF 未发送到模型接口。未填写第一教学周日期时，“今日”与“本周任务时间”不推测当前周。正式发布前仍需用不同学校的真实课表样本评估识别率、用自己选定的模型与密钥做联调，并决定是否制作独立 Windows 安装包。
````

```python
"""Local development host for T计划智能版. Python standard library only."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import base64
import json
import os
import pathlib
import zipfile
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer

from parser import MAX_FILE, extract_pdf_courses, extract_text, parse_excel_grid, parse_simple_lines

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
MIME = {"/": ("index.html", "text/html; charset=utf-8"),
        "/app.js": ("app.js", "text/javascript; charset=utf-8"),
        "/style.css": ("style.css", "text/css; charset=utf-8")}
EXT_MIME = {"pdf": "application/pdf", "png": "image/png", "jpg": "image/jpeg", "jpeg": "image/jpeg"}


def api_key() -> str:
    key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY", "").strip()
    if not key:
        raise ValueError("未配置 OPENAI_API_KEY；可先使用本地识别和手工编辑")
    return key


def openai_request(prompt: str, content: list[dict]) -> dict:
    model = os.environ.get("OPENAI_MODEL", "gpt-4.1-mini").strip()
    if not model:
        raise ValueError("OPENAI_MODEL 不能为空")
    body = {"model": model, "store": False,
            "input": [{"role": "system", "content": [{"type": "input_text", "text": prompt}]},
                      {"role": "user", "content": content}],
            "text": {"format": {"type": "json_object"}}}
    request = urllib.request.Request(
        "https://api.openai.com/v1/responses", data=json.dumps(body).encode("utf-8"),
        headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + api_key(), "Content-Type": "application/json"}, method="POST")
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=60) as response:
            result = json.load(response)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
        raise ValueError(f"模型接口返回 HTTP {error.code}；请检查模型、额度和密钥") from error
    except urllib.error.URLError as error:
        raise ValueError("无法连接模型接口，请检查网络") from error
    output = "".join(item.get("text", "") for row in result.get("output", [])
                     for item in row.get("content", []) if item.get("type") == "output_text")
    if not output:
        raise ValueError("模型没有返回可解析文本")
    try:
        return json.loads(output)
    except json.JSONDecodeError as error:
        raise ValueError("模型返回的内容不是 JSON") from error


def valid_course(value: dict) -> dict:
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise ValueError("课程格式错误")
    name = str(value.get("name", "")).strip()
    day, start, end = (value.get(k) for k in ("day", "start", "end"))
    weeks = value.get("weeks")
    if not name or len(name) > 100 or not all(type(x) is int for x in (day, start, end)):
        raise ValueError("课程名称或时间无效")
    if not (1 <= day <= 7 and 1 <= start <= end <= 20):
        raise ValueError("星期或节次超出范围")
    if not isinstance(weeks, list) or not weeks or len(weeks) > 30 or any(type(w) is not int or not 1 <= w <= 30 for w in weeks):
        raise ValueError("课程周次无效")
    return {"name": name, "day": day, "start": start, "end": end,
            "weeks": sorted(set(weeks)), "teacher": str(value.get("teacher") or "")[:100],
            "room": str(value.get("room") or "")[:100]}


EXTRACT_PROMPT = """你是学生课表结构化助手。只读取用户提供的课表，不猜测缺失字段。返回 JSON 对象：
{"courses":[{"name":"课程名","day":1,"start":1,"end":2,"weeks":[1,2],"teacher":"","room":""}],"warnings":["需要核实的内容"]}。
day 为周一=1 至周日=7；start/end 是节次序号而非钟点；weeks 是明确出现的教学周。单双周和周次范围须准确展开，无法确认周次的课程不要写入 courses，放入 warnings。图片或扫描件看不清时不要编造。"""
ANALYZE_PROMPT = """你是学习计划助手。返回 JSON 对象，字段为 summary（字符串）、actions（字符串数组）、questions（字符串数组）。
按用户给出的课程、任务、可用时间和目标给出可执行建议。不能假定教师、考试日期或作业要求；发现时间冲突应指出。输出是建议，不能替用户修改课程或任务。"""


def extract(body: dict) -> dict:
    name = str(body.get("name", ""))
    encoded = body.get("data", "")
    if len(encoded) > MAX_FILE * 2:
        raise ValueError("文件超过 10 MB")
    try:
        data = base64.b64decode(encoded, validate=True)
    except (ValueError, TypeError) as error:
        raise ValueError("上传数据不是有效的文件编码") from error
    text = extract_text(name, data)
    local = parse_simple_lines(text or "") or parse_excel_grid(text or "")
    local_warnings = []
    if name.lower().endswith(".pdf") and not body.get("useAI"):
        local, local_warnings = extract_pdf_courses(data)
    if not body.get("useAI"):
        return {"courses": [valid_course(c) for c in local], "warnings": local_warnings if local else local_warnings + [
            "本地规则未能可靠识别课程。可手工添加，或勾选使用 AI 识别并明确同意发送文件内容。"],
            "mode": "local"}
    ext = name.lower().rsplit(".", 1)[-1]
    if ext in EXT_MIME:
        if ext == "pdf":
            item = {"type": "input_file", "filename": name,
                    "file_data": "data:application/pdf;base64," + encoded}
        else:
            item = {"type": "input_image", "image_url": f"data:{EXT_MIME[ext]};base64,{encoded}"}
    else:
        if not text or not text.strip():
            raise ValueError("文件没有可读取的文字")
        item = {"type": "input_text", "text": text[:100000]}
    result = openai_request(EXTRACT_PROMPT, [item])
    courses = result.get("courses", [])
    if not isinstance(courses, list) or len(courses) > 200:
        raise ValueError("模型返回的课程数量或结构无效")
    warnings = result.get("warnings", [])
    if not isinstance(warnings, list):
        warnings = []
    return {"courses": [valid_course(c) for c in courses],
            "warnings": [str(w)[:300] for w in warnings[:30]], "mode": "ai"}


def analyze(body: dict) -> dict:
    courses = body.get("courses", [])
    tasks = body.get("tasks", [])
    if not isinstance(courses, list) or len(courses) > 200 or not isinstance(tasks, list) or len(tasks) > 200:
        raise ValueError("分析数据过多")
    clean = {"courses": [valid_course(c) for c in courses],
             "tasks": [{"title": str(t.get("title", ""))[:100], "date": str(t.get("date", ""))[:10],
                        "minutes": t.get("minutes", 0)} for t in tasks if isinstance(t, dict)],
             "goal": str(body.get("goal", ""))[:1000], "hoursPerWeek": body.get("hoursPerWeek", 0)}
    result = openai_request(ANALYZE_PROMPT, [{"type": "input_text", "text": json.dumps(clean, ensure_ascii=False)}])
    if not isinstance(result, dict):
        raise ValueError("模型返回的建议结构无效")
    actions, questions = result.get("actions"), result.get("questions")
    if not isinstance(actions, list) or not isinstance(questions, list):
        raise ValueError("模型返回的行动或待确认项格式无效")
    return {"summary": str(result.get("summary", ""))[:2000],
            "actions": [str(x)[:500] for x in actions[:10]],
            "questions": [str(x)[:500] for x in questions[:10]]}


class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def send_json(self, status: int, payload: dict):
        data = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
        self.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(data)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(data)

    def do_GET(self):
        item = MIME.get(self.path)
        if not item:
            return self.send_error(404)
        data = (ROOT / item[0]).read_bytes()
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", item[1])
        self.send_header("Content-Security-Policy", "default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'")
        self.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(data)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(data)

    def do_POST(self):
        if self.path not in {"/api/extract", "/api/analyze"}:
            return self.send_error(404)
        size = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", "0"))
        if size < 1 or size > MAX_FILE * 2 + 10000:
            return self.send_json(413, {"error": "请求超过允许大小"})
        origin = self.headers.get("Origin")
        if origin and origin != f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.server.server_port}":
            return self.send_json(403, {"error": "仅接受本地页面请求"})
        try:
            body = json.loads(self.rfile.read(size))
            if not isinstance(body, dict):
                raise ValueError("请求格式错误")
            result = extract(body) if self.path == "/api/extract" else analyze(body)
            self.send_json(200, result)
        except (ValueError, KeyError, zipfile.BadZipFile) as error:
            self.send_json(400, {"error": str(error)})
        except Exception:
            self.send_json(500, {"error": "处理失败；请检查文件格式或服务器日志"})

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        # Do not log request bodies, file contents, or API keys.
        super().log_message(fmt, *args)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=18766)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    with ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", args.port), Handler) as server:
        print(f"T计划智能版: http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_port}", flush=True)
        server.serve_forever()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```python
import base64
import io
import json
import unittest
import zipfile
from unittest.mock import patch

import parser
import server


def xlsx_fixture():
    xml = '''<worksheet xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main"><sheetData>
    <row r="1"><c r="A1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>节次</t></is></c><c r="B1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>周一</t></is></c><c r="C1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>周二</t></is></c></row>
    <row r="2"><c r="A2" t="inlineStr"><is><t>1-2节</t></is></c><c r="B2" t="inlineStr"><is><t>高等数学 第1-16周</t></is></c></row>
    </sheetData></worksheet>'''
    memory = io.BytesIO()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(memory, "w") as zf:
        zf.writestr("xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml", xml)
    return memory.getvalue()


class SmartPlanTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_local_excel_grid(self):
        result = server.extract({"name": "课表.xlsx", "data": base64.b64encode(xlsx_fixture()).decode(), "useAI": False})
        self.assertEqual(result["courses"], [{"name": "高等数学", "day": 1, "start": 1, "end": 2,
                                              "weeks": list(range(1, 17)), "teacher": "", "room": ""}])

    def test_simple_text_and_svg(self):
        self.assertEqual(parser.parse_simple_lines("周三 5-6节, 物理实验, 3-8周")[0]["day"], 3)
        self.assertIn("周一", parser.extract_svg('<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><text>周一</text></svg>'.encode()))

    def test_stacked_pdf_cell_and_nonconsecutive_weeks(self):
        cell = "课程甲\n教师甲\n1-5([周])[01-02节]\n一教101\n课程乙\n教师乙\n7,9,11,13([\n周])[01-02\n节]\n二教202"
        courses, warnings = parser._cell_courses(cell, 3)
        self.assertEqual(warnings, [])
        self.assertEqual(len(courses), 2)
        self.assertEqual(courses[0]["room"], "一教101")
        self.assertEqual(courses[1]["weeks"], [7, 9, 11, 13])

    def test_image_without_ai_keeps_data_local(self):
        result = server.extract({"name": "课表.png", "data": base64.b64encode(b"synthetic").decode(), "useAI": False})
        self.assertEqual(result["courses"], [])
        self.assertEqual(result["mode"], "local")

    def test_ai_result_rejected_when_invalid(self):
        with patch.object(server, "openai_request", return_value={"courses": [{"name": "课", "day": 8,
                   "start": 1, "end": 2, "weeks": [1]}], "warnings": []}):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                server.extract({"name": "课表.png", "data": base64.b64encode(b"synthetic").decode(), "useAI": True})

    def test_analysis_does_not_mutate_inputs(self):
        body = {"courses": [{"name": "高等数学", "day": 1, "start": 1, "end": 2, "weeks": [1]}],
                "tasks": [], "goal": "复习", "hoursPerWeek": 10}
        original = json.dumps(body, ensure_ascii=False)
        with patch.object(server, "openai_request", return_value={"summary": "建议", "actions": ["先复习"], "questions": []}):
            self.assertEqual(server.analyze(body)["actions"], ["先复习"])
        self.assertEqual(json.dumps(body, ensure_ascii=False), original)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```
